title: How 7 Everyday Things Were Invented by Accident
description:
In 1945, an engineer's candy bar melted in his pocket, and nothing near him was hot. That sticky pocket is why there's a microwave in your kitchen.

7 everyday inventions nobody meant to make, counted down from the smallest accident to the one that changed the world: a spring that walked off a shelf (the Slinky), burrs on a dog (Velcro), a glue that was too sticky and thrown away for 9 years (super glue), a gas cylinder that looked empty (non-stick pans), a flask that broke but didn't shatter (safety glass), the melted candy bar (the microwave oven), and the dirty dish that saved millions of lives (penicillin).
